I will do this plot almost the same way I did last season, only keeping costs low because this land is very small and cash is always tight. I own the plot, so I will put some manure there, and if I can share fertilizer with another farmer I will apply a small amount, not a full bag. I will keep my local sorghum seed because I know how it behaves here, and I will depend on family work and rain.
